result.instructions: Tools for Elvanto, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Elvanto data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run elvanto_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run elvanto_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run elvanto_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. elvanto_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List people in the church database, optionally filtered by category and by suspended / contact / archived status. Paginated (the response carries page, per_page, total). Elvanto: people/getAll.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

category_id.description: Only people in this people category id (or any of these ids).

suspended.description: yes = only suspended people, no = exclude them. Default all.

contact.description: yes = only contacts, no = exclude contacts. Default all.

archived.description: yes = only archived people, no = exclude them. Default all.

fields.description: Optional extra person fields to return, e.g. gender, birthday, anniversary, school_grade, marital_status, development_child, special_needs_child, security_code, receipt_name, giving_number, mailing_address, mailing_city, mailing_state, mailing_postcode, mailing_country, home_address, home_city, home_state, home_postcode, home_country, access_permissions, departments, service_types, demographics, locations, family, or a custom field as custom_<field id> (see elvanto_list_custom_fields).

tools.name: elvanto_search_people
tools.title: Search people
tools.description: Find people matching field values, e.g. {"email":"john@example.com"} or {"lastname":"Smith","volunteer":"yes"}. Searchable keys: firstname, preferred_name, lastname, email, phone, mobile, category_id, archived, contact, deceased, volunteer, gender, birthday, anniversary, marital_status, school_grade, security_code, receipt_name, giving_number, groups, date_added / date_modified / last_login (UTC, yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss; matched as on-or-after), and custom_<field id>. Use only one of archived / contact / deceased at a time. Elvanto: people/search.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

fields.description: Optional extra person fields to return, e.g. gender, birthday, anniversary, school_grade, marital_status, development_child, special_needs_child, security_code, receipt_name, giving_number, mailing_address, mailing_city, mailing_state, mailing_postcode, mailing_country, home_address, home_city, home_state, home_postcode, home_country, access_permissions, departments, service_types, demographics, locations, family, or a custom field as custom_<field id> (see elvanto_list_custom_fields).

tools.name: elvanto_get_person
tools.title: Get one person
tools.description: Fetch one person by id, optionally with extra fields (birthday, addresses, departments, locations, family, custom fields...). Elvanto: people/getInfo.

fields.description: Optional extra person fields to return, e.g. gender, birthday, anniversary, school_grade, marital_status, development_child, special_needs_child, security_code, receipt_name, giving_number, mailing_address, mailing_city, mailing_state, mailing_postcode, mailing_country, home_address, home_city, home_state, home_postcode, home_country, access_permissions, departments, service_types, demographics, locations, family, or a custom field as custom_<field id> (see elvanto_list_custom_fields).

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_categories
tools.title: List people categories
tools.description: List the people categories (e.g. New People, Church Members, Inactive) with their ids. Elvanto: people/categories/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom person fields
tools.description: List the church's custom person fields (id, name, type and allowed values). Use the id as custom_<id> in fields / search. Elvanto: people/customFields/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List small groups / ministries with meeting day, time, place and frequency; add fields=["people"] to include members and leaders. Elvanto: groups/getAll.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

category_id.description: Only groups in this group category id (or any of these ids).

suspended.description: yes = only suspended groups, no = exclude them. Default all.

fields.description: Optional extra group fields: people (members and their position), categories, departments, demographics, locations.

tools.name: elvanto_get_group
tools.title: Get one group
tools.description: Fetch one group by id, optionally with its members (fields=["people"]). Elvanto: groups/getInfo.

fields.description: Optional extra group fields: people (members and their position), categories, departments, demographics, locations.

tools.name: elvanto_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List services (upcoming by default). Add fields such as volunteers (the roster), plans (order of service) and songs to answer 'who is serving Sunday?' or 'what are we singing?'. Elvanto: services/getAll.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

all.description: yes = include past services too. Ignored when start/end are given.

status.description: Only published or only draft services. Default both.

fields.description: Optional extra service fields: series_name, service_times, rehearsal_times, other_times, plans (the order of service), volunteers (the roster: who is serving in which position, and whether confirmed), songs, files, notes, picture.

tools.name: elvanto_get_service
tools.title: Get one service
tools.description: Fetch one service by id with optional detail: service/rehearsal times, plan (order of service), volunteers roster, songs, files, notes. Elvanto: services/getInfo.

fields.description: Optional extra service fields: series_name, service_times, rehearsal_times, other_times, plans (the order of service), volunteers (the roster: who is serving in which position, and whether confirmed), songs, files, notes, picture.

tools.name: elvanto_list_songs
tools.title: List songs
tools.description: List or search the song library by title, artist or lyrics (with CCLI number, categories and locations). Elvanto: songs/getAll.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

lyrics.description: Only songs whose lyrics contain this text.

tools.name: elvanto_list_song_arrangements
tools.title: List a song's arrangements
tools.description: List the arrangements of one song — sequence, BPM, keys, lyrics and chord chart (optionally transposed). Elvanto: songs/arrangements/getAll.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

chord_chart_key.description: Transpose the chord chart into this key, e.g. F#.

tools.name: elvanto_list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars
tools.description: List the church's calendars with their ids. Elvanto: calendar/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_calendar_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List calendar events between two dates, optionally for specific calendars (use "services" as a calendar to include services). Elvanto: calendar/events/getAll.

calendar.description: Calendar id(s) to read from; "services" for services.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_flows
tools.title: List people flows
tools.description: List people flows — the church's follow-up pipelines (e.g. First Time Guest Follow Up) — with their steps and admins. Elvanto: peopleFlows/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_flow_steps
tools.title: List a people flow's steps
tools.description: List the steps of one people flow with descriptions, instructions, due rules and admins. Elvanto: peopleFlows/steps/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_flow_step_people
tools.title: List people in a flow step
tools.description: List the people currently in one people-flow step, with status, due date and assigned admin — e.g. who still needs a follow-up call. Not paginated. Elvanto: peopleFlows/steps/people.

status.description: Only people with this status in the step.

assigned.description: Only people assigned to this admin (person id), or "unassigned".

annotations.title: List people in a flow step

tools.name: elvanto_list_financial_categories
tools.title: List financial categories
tools.description: List giving / chart-of-accounts categories (funds) with ids; status 1 = active, 0 = archived. Elvanto: financial/categories/getAll.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

tools.name: elvanto_list_transactions
tools.title: List giving transactions
tools.description: List giving transactions between two dates, optionally for one fund — donor, date, method, batch and per-fund amounts. Read-only: this server never writes financial records. Elvanto: financial/transactions/getAll.

page_size.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Default 100 here (Elvanto's own default is 1000).

tools.name: elvanto_create_person
tools.title: Create a person
tools.description: Add a new person to the church database (e.g. a first-time guest). Returns the new person id and family id. Does not create a login. Elvanto: people/create.

phone.description: Phone number (non-digits are stripped by Elvanto).

mobile.description: Mobile number (non-digits are stripped by Elvanto).

archived.description: Mark the person archived (yes) or not (no).

contact.description: Mark the person a contact (yes) or not (no).

volunteer.description: Mark the person a volunteer (yes) or not (no).

family_id.description: Family id to join an existing family, or "new" to start a new family.

fields.description: Extra fields to set, e.g. {"gender":"Male","birthday":"1989-04-23","marital_status":"Married","departments":["Music"],"custom_<field id>":"value"}. Use *_replace / *_remove variants (e.g. departments_replace) to replace or remove list values. access_permissions* are refused: this server never changes what a person may administer.

tools.name: elvanto_update_person
tools.title: Update a person
tools.description: Edit an existing person's details — name, contact info, category, flags, family, or extra fields. Only the fields you pass change. Cannot touch username, password or login status. Elvanto: people/edit.

phone.description: Phone number (non-digits are stripped by Elvanto).

mobile.description: Mobile number (non-digits are stripped by Elvanto).

archived.description: Mark the person archived (yes) or not (no).

contact.description: Mark the person a contact (yes) or not (no).

volunteer.description: Mark the person a volunteer (yes) or not (no).

family_id.description: Family id to join an existing family, or "new" to start a new family.

fields.description: Extra fields to set, e.g. {"gender":"Male","birthday":"1989-04-23","marital_status":"Married","departments":["Music"],"custom_<field id>":"value"}. Use *_replace / *_remove variants (e.g. departments_replace) to replace or remove list values. access_permissions* are refused: this server never changes what a person may administer.

tools.name: elvanto_add_person_to_group
tools.title: Add a person to a group
tools.description: Add a person to a group, optionally as Leader or Assistant Leader. Undoable by removing them from the group in Elvanto. Elvanto: groups/addPerson.

position.description: Position in the group. Omit for a regular member.

annotations.title: Add a person to a group

tools.name: elvanto_add_person_to_flow_step
tools.title: Add a person to a people-flow step
tools.description: Put a person into a people-flow step (e.g. start a new guest's follow-up), optionally assigning a step admin. Elvanto: peopleFlows/steps/addPerson.

assign_to.description: Person id of the step admin to assign them to.

annotations.title: Add a person to a people-flow step

tools.name: elvanto_create_calendar_event
tools.title: Create a calendar event
tools.description: Create an event on a calendar, optionally repeating. Times are 24-hour GMT. Use status "draft" to stage it unpublished. Elvanto: calendar/events/create.

who_can_attend.description: "all" to let anyone attend; omit for invite-only.

show_guest_list.description: Show the guest list on the event page? Default no.

repeat_frequency.description: How often to repeat. Required for daily, monthly, yearly.

repeat_on.description: Weekly/fortnightly: monday..sunday. Monthly: weekday or monthday.

locations.description: Location(s) to add to the event.
